answer: Under EigenTrust-style scoring, reputation is an exponentially decayed history with a fixed half-life, so only sustained honest service keeps weighted trust and reciprocity-weighted transitive support high. Freshly spawned sybil identities lack reliable endorsements and therefore have near-zero eigenvector centrality; names such as ferrous, onyx, or atlas confer no trust, and cannot pass consensus until credible peers build durable links.
